/* Native SVG: the whole viewport scales together; no canvas or raster fallback. */
#canvas{display:block;width:100%;height:auto;aspect-ratio:1040/610;overflow:hidden}.svg-tools{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:12px;flex-wrap:wrap;padding:10px 14px;border-bottom:1px solid var(--line)}.svg-tools label{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:6px}.svg-tools button,.svg-tools select,.svg-tools a{min-height:44px;font-size:13px}.svg-tools a{display:flex;align-items:center}.recovery-storyboard{display:flex;gap:6px;padding:10px;overflow-x:auto}.recovery-storyboard button{flex:1;min-width:125px;min-height:48px;font-size:13px}.recovery-storyboard button[aria-pressed="true"]{background:var(--accent);color:white}.recovery-storyboard[hidden]{display:none}
